The lifestyle hotel brings modern hospitality to the heart of Guadalajara


- **Hilton announces the opening of Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico, a 154-room lifestyle hotel in the heart of Guadalajara’s historic center, housed in a restored 1950s Art Deco building.**
- **The hotel introduces Motto by Hilton’s neighborhood-driven hospitality experience with cleverly compact rooms, flexible accommodations, and locally inspired food and beverage concepts.**
- **Located one block from Plaza Fundadores, the hotel places guests within walking distance of Guadalajara’s most iconic cultural attractions, reinforcing Hilton’s growing presence in Mexico and across the Caribbean and Latin America.**


**GUADALAJARA, Jalisco –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) (NYSE: HLT) today announces the opening of[Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico](https://www.mottobyhilton.com/guadalajaracentrohistorico) , a 154-room lifestyle hotel in the heart of Guadalajara’s historic center. Owned and developed by Grupo Megaterra, the hotel is housed in a restored 1950s Art Deco building and introduces Motto by Hilton’s neighborhood-driven hospitality experience to one of Mexico’s most culturally rich urban destinations.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico - Lobby Commons


“The opening of Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico marks an exciting milestone as our second Motto property in Mexico and reflects our continued focus on expanding Hilton’s lifestyle portfolio in vibrant destinations across the region,” said Maxime Verstraete, vice president, brand management, Caribbean and Latin America, Hilton. “Guadalajara is a city defined by culture, creativity and energy, making it a natural fit for the Motto brand. With this opening, we are offering travelers a new way to experience the city through thoughtfully designed spaces, flexible accommodations and a stay that feels connected to the neighborhood around them.”


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico - Lobby Front Desk


Originally designed by Agustín Acevedo in the 1950s as a residential apartment building, the property stands as a local expression of functionalist Art Deco architecture. Today, it has been thoughtfully reimagined as Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Histórico, exemplifying the brand’s approach to modern travel through its prime urban location, cleverly compact rooms and locally inspired experiences. While its purpose has evolved, the building continues to bridge its modernist heritage with a renewed role in Guadalajara’s historic heart.


Ideal for explorers seeking to experience destinations from the inside out, Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico places guests at the center of the city’s cultural and social scene. Located just one block from Plaza Fundadores, the birthplace of Guadalajara, the hotel offers immediate access to the destination’s rich history, architecture and vibrant local culture. Guests are within walking distance of some of the city’s most iconic attractions, including Teatro Degollado, Instituto Cultural Cabañas, Guadalajara Cathedral and San Juan Market, making the hotel an ideal launchpad to discover the energy and authenticity of Guadalajara.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico - Bunk Room


Guest rooms were designed with flexibility in mind and are easily adaptable with muti-functional furniture and Hilton’s pioneering Confirmed Connecting Room technology, which offers several connecting room configurations to accommodate groups of all sizes. There are 69 connecting rooms, with the option to link up to 3 at once.

Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico - Top: Restaurant - La BienQuerida, Bottom: Cafe Dona Elvira


To further encourage connection, the hotel’s public spaces are anchored in two food & beverage concepts that serve as a gathering point for guests and locals alike. La BienQuerida is Motto Guadalajara’s full-service restaurant concept, serving locally inspired food and beverage that offers a modern take on traditional Mexican cantinas. Doña Elvira, the hotel’s other food & beverage outlet, is a vibrant café serving up traditional Mexican breads and artisanal coffees for guests and locals alike.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico - Main Entrance


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Histórico is part of Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest-loyalty program for Hilton’s portfolio of brands. Members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels enjoy instant benefits, including flexible Points and money booking options, exclusive member discounts and complimentary standard Wi-Fi. Through the Hilton Honors mobile app, guests can also check in, choose their room and access it digitally.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Histórico joins Hilton’s growing portfolio of more than 300 hotels currently welcoming guests across the Caribbean and Latin America, including a strong and expanding presence in Mexico. The company continues to grow its footprint in the region with a pipeline of more than 150 properties in various stages of development, reinforcing its commitment to delivering innovative hospitality experiences in key urban and resort destinations.


For more information or to make reservations, please visit[Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico](https://www.mottobyhilton.com/guadalajaracentrohistorico) or call +52 1 33 9689 4187.


Read more about Motto at[stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/) .


##### FAQ: Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico Opens


Hilton announced the opening of Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico, a 154-room lifestyle hotel in the heart of Guadalajara’s historic center.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico is a 154-room lifestyle hotel housed in a restored 1950s Art Deco building that introduces Motto by Hilton’s neighborhood-driven hospitality experience.


Motto Guadalajara Centro Historico opened in Summer 2026.


Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico is located in the heart of Guadalajara’s historic center, just one block from Plaza Fundadores and within walking distance of Teatro Degollado, Instituto Cultural Cabañas, Guadalajara Cathedral and San Juan Market.


The opening marks an exciting milestone as the second Motto property in Mexico and reflects Hilton’s continued focus on expanding its lifestyle portfolio in vibrant destinations across the region, while reinforcing its growing presence in Mexico and across the Caribbean and Latin America.


The hotel offers thoughtfully designed spaces, cleverly compact rooms, flexible accommodations, locally inspired food and beverage concepts, and a stay that feels connected to the neighborhood, placing guests at the center of the city’s cultural and social scene.
